notes.title: Here are the patch notes for patch 1.3.1!
notes.content:
Fixed: Easy level, some frustrating parts has been deleted or modified.
Fixed: Second Boss Machine has been set to two levers. 
Fixed: Some colliders has been added in level 6 (fence)
Fixed: A new follow camera has been added with new configurations values, in order to improve interactions with objects.
Fixed: Spanish Errors in spelling.
Fixed: Inmate 39 running animation
Fixed: Checkpoint and keys issues.
Fixed: Some landmines crash the game.
Fixed: Balance rope issue
Fixed: Chapter six Low frame rate.

We have been focused on improving the game, We are constantly reading opinions and suggestions in order to polish the game and looking forward to hearing your comments and opinions, as well as answer any questions you might have!

notes.title: New Upgrade! New Options!
notes.content:
[h1]We are pleased to announce the addition of three new game options:[/h1] 

[b] Brightness[/b] 
 [list]
[*]You can increase the brightness of the game.
[/list] 
[b] Camera[/b]
 [list]
[*]Choose between fixed angle camera (current in game) and follow camera. 
 [/list] 
[b] Dificulty level [/b]
 [list]
[*]Select "Classic" for a hardcore level (current in game)
[*]Select "Normal" for medium level 
[*]Select "Easy" for ... come on ! really?
[/list] 

Hope you enjoy them! 

[i]Note: All bugs have been fixed, sorry for that![/i]
